metadata.title: Mst. JAMILA BANO and others vs JAWAID IQBAL

full_text:
2009 Y L R 2269

[Karachi]

Before Anwar Zaheer Jamali, C J

Mst. JAMILA BANO and others---Applicants

Versus

JAWAID IQBAL---Respondent

C.T.A. No.45 of 2008, decided on 15th December, 2008.

West Pakistan Family Courts Act (XXXV of 1964)---

----S. 25-A---Transfer of case---Application
for---Applicants had sought transfer of Guardianship Application pending before
the court at place and family case pending before the court of Family Judge D'
to place `K'---Respondent despite notices, had not turned up to oppose the
grant of request for transfer of cases which otherwise seemed to be reasonable;
and to avoid inconvenience to applicants and her two minor daughters who were
reported to be living at `K'---Both the transfer applications were
granted---Family suit pending before the Family Court was transferred to the
Family Court `K', so that it could be proceeded along with Family suit instituted
by the applicant---Guardianship Application was also transferred to same Family
Court for its disposal according to law.

Javed Ahmed Rajput for Applicant.

ORDER

ANWAR ZAHEER JAMALI, C.J.---Mr. Javed Ahmad
Rajput Advocate has placed on record copies of two T.C.S. receipts to show that
the service of notice of these transfer applications has been duly effected on
respondent Jawaid Iqbal.

None present for the respondent, despite repeated
calls.

Through these two transfer applications moved by the
applicants, they have sought transfer of Guardianship Application No.21 of 2008
pending before the Court of II-Additional District Judge, Mirpurkhas, and
Family No.20 of 2008 pending before the Court of Family Judge/Civil Judge Digri
to Karachi.

In this regard, the case of applicants is that they
are residing at Karachi and Family Suit No.1657 of 2008 instituted by Applicant
No.1 Mst. Jamila Bano is already sub-judiced before the Court of XIX-Family
Judge Karachi East, therefore, it will just and proper that two cases filed by
the respondent at District Mirpurkhas are transferred to Karachi.

Respondent despite notices has not turned up to
oppose the grant of such request, which otherwise seems to be reasonable and to
avoid inconvenience to the application and her two minor daughters Momal Jawaid
and Maryam Jawaid, who are reported to be living at Karachi.

This being the position, both the Transfer
applications are granted. Accordingly, Family Suit No.20 of 2008 presently
pending before the Court of Family/Civil Judge Digri is transferred to the
Court of XIX-Family Judge, Karachi East so that it may be proceeded along with
Family Suit No.1657 of 2008 instituted by the Applicant No.1. Further
Guardianship Application No.21 of 2008 is also transferred to the same Family
Court for its disposal according to law.

H.B.T./J-13/K Appeal
allowed.
